traceId.description: Correlates the response with server logs; include it in bug reports.

HttpValidationProblemDetails.description: 422 validation error. "errors" maps camelCase JSON paths of the request ("fullName", "arrival.entryPoint", "stays[0].placeName") to messages.

NotificationType.description: 1 = AnnouncementPosted, 2 = MemberJoinedGroup, 3 = GroupCreated, 4 = SupervisorActivated, 5 = GroupWithoutSupervisor, 6 = GatheringPointChanged, 7 = PilgrimArrived, 8 = GroupMessagePosted, 9 = SupervisorMessagePosted, 10 = EmergencyReported, 11 = LostChildReported, 12 = FamilyMemberJoined

traceId.description: Correlates the response with server logs; include it in bug reports.

code.description: Stable error code such as "Auth.InvalidCredentials". Absent on framework 401/403, 422 and 500.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 error. Business errors carry a stable machine-readable "code" (Area.Reason, e.g. "Group.AlreadyMember"); branch on it, not on "title" (English, for logs).

RitualPhase.description: 1 = Preparation, 2 = Ihram, 3 = Tawaf, 4 = Sai, 5 = HalqOrTaqsir, 6 = Completion
